cohort: 1,358 birth hospitalizations at affiliated hospitals during two periods: (i) the apex of the 'first wave' of the COVID-19 pandemic in New York City (3/22/20 to 4/30/20) and (ii) a historical control period of one year earlier (3/22/19 to 4/30/19)
finding: Expedited postpartum discharge was not associated with increased risk for acute postpartum care utilization.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased likelihood of expedited postpartum discharge.
